# BESTAR METAL

> BESTAR METAL is the brand of Shenzhen Bestar Tek Co. Ltd. It coordinates OEM and ODM custom metal product development, prototyping and manufacturing for overseas B2B customers through its authorized production partner, Dongguan Zhiqin Yipin Hardware Co., Ltd., in Dongguan, China. Factory address: Room 101, Building 5, No. 15 Chaodong Road, Chashan Town, Dongguan City, Guangdong Province, China. Photographs on the website are supplied by the production partner and do not imply design ownership by BESTAR METAL.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://bestarmetal.com/): OEM/ODM overview and buyer questions
- [Products](https://bestarmetal.com/products.html): reference products and categories
- [Design & Engineering](https://bestarmetal.com/design-engineering.html): six-stage process from idea to production
- [Manufacturing](https://bestarmetal.com/manufacturing.html): partner workshop photographs and production coordination
- [Industries](https://bestarmetal.com/industries.html): possible applications
- [Prototyping](https://bestarmetal.com/prototyping.html): prototypes and small batches; MOQ, costs and lead time evaluated per project
- [About](https://bestarmetal.com/about.html)
